mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ymd , t1.PROPOSER AS proposer , t1.TITLE AS title , t1.MATTER AS matter , TO_CHAR(t1.CONTENT_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS contentYmd , t1.CONTENT AS content , t1.FEXP AS fexp , t1.ORG_FNAME AS orgFname , CASE WHEN TRUNC(t1.YMD) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS saveVisible FROM PROPOSAL t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC

SELECT pa.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(pa.P_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS pYmd , pa.P_PROPOSER AS pProposer , TO_CHAR(pa.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ymd , pa.SB_NM AS sbNm , pa.APPENDING AS appending , CASE WHEN pa.SB_NM = #{gsUser} THEN 16711680 ELSE 33554432 END AS color FROM PROPOSAL_APPEND pa WHERE pa.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND pa.P_YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND pa.P_PROPOSER = #{proposer} ORDER BY pa.YMD DESC
